instantiation: lazy singleton; no requests occur until an explicit requestVideoID call

api.configure: RVDeArrowOptions.defaultOptions supplies independent branding and thumbnail endpoints. Successful configuration copies options. Changed options advance configurationRevision and invalidate outstanding consumers. Invalid options return NO and leave the current configuration intact.
api.request: requestVideoID:parts:clientGeneration:completion: accepts independent title/thumbnail masks and returns an RVDeArrowRequest cancellation token.
api.delivery: Asynchronous main-queue immutable RVDeArrowResult snapshots. A combined request may first deliver a usable title with a pending image, then a final snapshot. A title-only request is final after metadata. Multiple consumers of the same video share transport work; cancelling one does not cancel the others.
api.revision: Each snapshot includes configurationRevision and clientGeneration. Check both plus the owner's current video before applying it. Backend rejects obsolete configuration deliveries, but the UI must reject obsolete native binding generations. configurationRevision is authoritative even for previously completed tokens.
api.custom_image: thumbnailDecision==Custom only means a community timestamp was selected. Use thumbnailImage only when imageState==Ready. Nil images always mean keep the original, including pending/error/original decisions.
api.custom_title: Use title only when titleDecision==Custom. Original, Missing, Untrusted, Invalid, Unavailable and Disabled decisions preserve native text. titleBlocker and thumbnailSelectionBlocker distinguish intentional originals, missing submissions and bad/untrusted candidates from metadata transport failure.
api.cancel: Retain the request in the native binding and cancel it on reuse/teardown. Cancel suppresses queued/future delivery but cannot revoke a block already executing. Completion closures must weakly capture native owners.
api.diagnostics: diagnostics returns redacted enums, counters, per-session video hashes, network status and bounded event history. recordCheckpoint:blocker: on the token accepts D02/D03/D04/D09/D10/D11/D12 from the presentation adapter. Transport checkpoints remain backend-owned.
api.cache_clear: clearCaches invalidates active consumers, advances configurationRevision, clears bounded memory caches and the dedicated metadata file. The UI should restore/rebind its own presentations afterwards.

protocol.metadata: GET <brandingEndpoint>/<first 4 hex chars of SHA256(videoID)>. Select the exact video key from the bucket; do not use another video's record.
protocol.candidate_policy: Select only the top candidate independently per feature. Require valid booleans, finite votes, and either locked==true or votes>=0. A trusted original candidate preserves native presentation; never search lower candidates to override it.
protocol.title_cleanup: Remove only upstream formatter escape markers at word boundaries using (^|\s)>(\S), then trim outer whitespace. Preserve submitted capitalization and literal comparison symbols. Bound titles to 1024 UTF-16 units and reject invalid control characters.
protocol.image: GET <thumbnailEndpoint>?videoID=<id>&time=<selected timestamp>. Reserved query keys are replaced. No redirectUrl, account credentials, submissions, local player capture or random-frame generation.
protocol.image_validation: Require HTTP 200, agreeing X-Timestamp rounded to 3 decimals, an accepted image MIME, single-frame ImageIO decode and bounded dimensions. Reject all redirects rather than counting original-image fallbacks as custom success. Ignore X-Title fallback as an unverified title source.
protocol.errors: Title and thumbnail decisions/failures remain separate. Respect bounded Retry-After cooldown on 429 and a short cooldown on server/network failure. No automatic infinite retry loop. A later request/rebind after cache expiry can retry.
protocol.privacy: Ephemeral sessions disable URLCache, cookie storage/acceptance and credential storage; only default system TLS trust is used. Metadata uses hash-prefix privacy; thumbnail generation still discloses the requested video ID to the image service.

cache.memory: TTL and least-recently-used eviction on a dedicated serial queue. Decoded images and metadata decisions are independent. In-flight tasks are outside evictable caches.
cache.disk: Only sanitized selected metadata decisions persist in the app Caches/RVPort.DeArrow/branding-v1.json file. Schema, branding-endpoint hash, types, sizes, IDs and expiry are checked on loading. No views, pointers, account identifiers or decoded images are persisted. Cached and fresh results traverse the same delivery adapter. Stored titles are validated without applying escape-marker cleanup again, so relaunch cannot progressively alter their wording.

ui_handoff: Resolve feature policy and owner surface in the UI; configure backend endpoints/cache preferences once, rather than reconfiguring per video.
Only request after establishing a positive ordinary-video binding and ad exclusion. The backend validates ID syntax; it cannot identify which native node is an ad, title or thumbnail.
Cancel the previous token, advance your binding generation and retain a new token on each actual source/video change.
Apply snapshots only while owner/video/generation/configuration still agree. Cache the original native presentation in the UI and restore it for non-custom decisions or Show original.
Do not clear a title on metadata-to-image progress delivery. Do not clear the original image while imageState is Pending or Unavailable.
Use native component visibility/reuse/rematerialization callbacks to rebind. Do not rely on pause/unpause or another app launch to refresh.
Stop the old RVThumbnailURL DeArrow image-header probe path for surfaces owned by the new adapter; leave YouTube still/proxy behavior explicit to avoid double image requests or nested URL rewriting.
Add backend.diagnostics to full diagnostics and a dedicated copy action. Record presentation checkpoints only after observing the corresponding native target/layout/restore operation.
Add DeArrow service/database attribution in About when exposing the feature. Full formatter, voting/submission, arbitrary uploads and personal overrides are outside this backend scope.
Bump/package only the one latest combined version after UI wiring and merge. This backend branch intentionally produces no IPA variant.
